items.title: Howard Mandel interviewed by Monk Rowe, Toronto, Canada, January 9, 2003
items.q: And Nat wrote some really great tunes.

ctx.x: Well I think that’s the one that came out afterward. I think there was one before that. He had played “Streets of New York” and — a very good album, very underrated musician in a lot of ways. And Nat wrote some really great tunes.
Oh, I guess he did. Tell me about the Jazz Journalists Association. Do you think that there’s a responsibility. Let me rephrase that — some musicians don’t like critics.
